author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: Registry Red Tape
challenge.description: #model_monica# insists the model registry must be automated; they can't work without it. But #requirements_reuben# won't allow it, insisting it must be governed first. #model_monica# says that's a nonstarter.

output.content: I've been thinking about the model registry situation. If we can't use our custom tool, we'd need to look at alternatives. I've heard good things about some of the commercial options out there. They might not have all the bells and whistles of our custom tool, but they'd get the job done. It's not ideal, but if that's what it takes to move forward, I'm open to it. We just need to make sure whatever we choose meets our security and scalability requirements. I'm happy to help evaluate other options if needed.
output.reclassify_reason: The author is willing to accept losing some features of their custom tool for the sake of moving forward with a commercial alternative.
